entity.name: Metis Team
entity.description: Metis is maintained by an academic and technical research team working to make advanced statistical modelling accessible to students, researchers, lecturers, and academic teams affected by software cost, licensing restrictions, and coding barriers.

projects.name: Metis
projects.description: Metis currently ships as version 0.3.1 for Windows and macOS. It is a free desktop application for Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM), Bootstrapping, PLSpredict, MICOM (Measurement Invariance for Composite Models), and automated Tark publication-ready reporting. Metis provides a visual interface for importing datasets, building models, running analyses, reviewing results, and exporting outputs while using R and SEMinR as its analytical foundation. Metis supports reproducible research and lowers the barrier to advanced statistical modelling for students, lecturers, researchers, and academic teams affected by software cost, licensing restrictions, or coding requirements.

channels.description: Bank transfer details can be provided by email for institutional, grant-based, or direct project support.

plans.name: Metis 2026 sustainability grant
plans.description: Funding will support Metis beyond its current Windows and macOS public releases. This includes Windows code signing, release infrastructure, documentation, Linux packaging, ongoing Windows and macOS build maintenance, testing, academic workshops, developer time, bug fixes, and long-term maintenance so the tool can remain free for research and education communities.

plans.name: Developer maintenance support
plans.description: Monthly support for continued development, dependency updates, bug fixes, user support, reproducibility improvements, documentation, and maintenance of the Metis desktop application.

plans.name: Goodwill support
plans.description: Supporters may contribute any amount to help keep Metis free and accessible for students, researchers, lecturers, and academic communities.

history.description: Metis has current public releases for Windows and macOS (version 0.3.1) and has not yet received structured external funding.
